result.summary: The layout is largely consistent, but the favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card is styled differently from the first one and has very poor contrast, making it hard to see and inconsistent with the rest of the page.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) uses a dark, semi-opaque circle with a dark heart outline, whereas the identical control on the ramen card above uses a white circle with a dark heart. The button is nearly invisible against the dark image, breaking visual consistency.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button style (e.g., white circular background with dark outlined heart, or a solid contrasting overlay) for all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The heart icon on the second card has insufficient contrast against its dark background/overlay, so the favorite action may not be perceivable to low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon and its background meet at least 3:1 contrast, e.g., a white icon on a dark scrim or a dark icon on a light scrim.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is inconsistent: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a light grey background while the neighboring cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds/overlays across carousel thumbnails so cards read as a uniform set.
